title: Grab receipts to Excel email report
subtitle: Retrieve Grab e-receipts, extract details, export to Excel, and send the report.

steps.title: Retrieve Grab e-receipts
steps.evidence: Use the Outlook retrieval step and set the Account field to the email account connected to Grab.

steps.title: Extract receipt values
steps.evidence: The flow extracts the price, date and time, and shop name.

steps.title: Organize results in a data table
steps.evidence: It stores these values in lists before organizing them into a data table.

steps.title: Export and email the report
steps.evidence: The flow exports the organized data to an Excel file and sends the report by email.
